item.tib: lung ston pa ka lA pa'i mdo'i 'grel pa slob ma la phan pa
item.coloph: jo bo drag 'byor gyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa slob ma la phan pa kun tu thob po zhes pa'o/ 'di ni chos kyi rje skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu thub pa'i dbang po dang mkhyen rabs mi gnyis pa dpal ldan blo gros brtan pa'i bka' drin las/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsungs rab dang tha snyad kyi gtsug lag rnams la blo gros rgya cher thob pa/ gangs can gyi khrod du skad gnyis smra ba shAkya'i dge slong byang chub rtse mos dgas po rdzam yul du bsgyur ba rdzogs so
